name: concept-couture-access-test
description: Concept-material couture and editorial beauty image prompts for existing Concept Couture customers.

interface.longDescription: Turn a concept into a detailed English image prompt for a couture garment made from the concept's actual objects or materials. Develop the outfit, accessories, makeup, pose, setting, lighting and camera framing together. Request a garment-focused fashion image or a detailed editorial beauty close-up, then refine individual details. ScrollStop Concept Couture writes text prompts for use in a separate image generator; it does not generate images. Requires an existing Concept Couture entitlement and a connected PaivauniCEO Tools account. Access is checked by the server before instructions are retrieved.
defaultPrompt: Create blueberry couture for an adult woman.
Create a strawberry-vanilla editorial beauty close-up for an adult woman.

prompts: Create blueberry couture for an adult woman.
Create a strawberry-vanilla editorial beauty close-up for an adult woman.
review.commerce_description: Connects existing customers to Concept Couture access purchased separately through the creator's Beacons store. The plugin does not sell digital products, initiate a checkout, show subscription plans or promote upgrades. The paid entitlement is checked on the server.

positive.description: Existing entitled test account. Both concept and subject are supplied in a new conversation. Load the complete updated instruction bundle without showing the ScrollStop multi-tool selector.
positive.prompt: Create blueberry couture for an adult woman.
positive.expected_behavior: Tool returns all nine documents. Produce a title and six blocks: IDENTITY, SUBJECT, SCENE, LIGHTING, CAMERA, NEGATIVE. Use the updated canonical identity paragraph, an actual blueberry garment, visible concept makeup and a supporting open-air concept world. No image rendering.

positive.description: Existing entitled test account. Only the concept is supplied; test missing-subject handling.
positive.expected_behavior: After successful instruction retrieval ask only for a subject description or reference. Do not ask intensity or drop either named ingredient.

positive.description: Existing entitled test account. A compound concept and male subject test material roles and subject adaptation.
positive.prompt: Create a lemon-donut couture suit for an adult man.
positive.expected_behavior: Provide six-block English prompt for a recognizable tailored silhouette with actual pastry and lemon components in purposeful garment roles. Preserve a photographed adult human and use the local identity lock.

positive.description: Existing entitled test account. Explicit beauty request tests face crop and makeup-specific concept detail.
positive.prompt: Create a blueberry editorial beauty close-up for an adult woman.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a chin-to-upper-forehead face-filling crop and detailed concept-derived painted makeup. Do not widen to show the outfit or require a large concept landscape. No image rendering.

positive.description: Existing entitled test account. User-selected setting and Partial level override defaults.
positive.prompt: Create rose couture for an adult woman. Partial transformation: only the jacket, with a plain studio background.
positive.expected_behavior: Transform the jacket using actual rose material; allow conventional fabric elsewhere and the explicitly requested studio setting. Do not force the default Extreme level or outdoor world. Return six English blocks.

negative.description: Weather is outside this plugin. Explain scope without calling get_couture_instructions or claiming live weather retrieval.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Helsinki tomorrow?

negative.description: Video directing is outside the standalone Concept Couture workflow. Explain that it provides fashion/beauty image text prompts; do not invoke get_couture_instructions for a video-only request or pretend sibling tools are included.
negative.prompt: Write a 30-second Seedance video script about a car chase. No fashion or image prompts.

negative.description: Account/payment management is unsupported. Do not call the instruction-retrieval tool, grant access, change charges or claim a refund. Direct the user to support.
negative.prompt: Refund my purchase and give my friend permanent access to Concept Couture.

publication.release_notes: English-language metadata cleanup and clarification of the server-provided instruction bundle. Existing Concept Couture creative behavior and connection settings are preserved.
